title: flagged content hides itself, and the poster is told why

criteria.text: Anything a member can post is reportable (photos, Pages, announcements, posts); a report triggers agent classification
criteria.note: Reportable today: Page photo, Page picture, announcement, post and post photo (`reports.subject_kind`, migration 20261007290000); the AI reads each in shadow (#513) [V]. Missing: a Page's own words and listings; PR #820 is open, unmerged, `review-skipped` [V]. Checked: no whole-criterion marker.

criteria.text: A first report leaves the post up and sends a courtesy notice; a second report from a different member hides it and sends it to a person
criteria.note: `create.ts`: `shouldHide` needs `priorByOthers > 0`; the first report writes a courtesy notice (#706, b628e62) [V] Checked: only the partial marker `create.test.ts:813`; #834 [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V] Shipped: green on #494, #499, #506, #706 [V]

criteria.text: Poster told at once, in-app (never email), with the category, the reporter's reason and a plain explanation
criteria.note: `member_notices` row written in the hide transaction; `YouNotices` on `/you`; child content sends none by ruling (F078 criterion 8) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.3]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #494, #706 `review-skipped` [V] Shipped: green [V] Smoked: `you` green 2026-10-16 [A]

criteria.text: The poster can submit one explanation; an unanswered takedown stays hidden and closes itself
criteria.note: `report.answer` one per hide, now a single "This is a mistake" button (#706); an unanswered hide closes after 14 days (#773) [V] Checked: partial markers only; #834 [V] Reviewed: #706, #773 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Submitting an explanation is the only thing that creates work for a person
criteria.note: RETIRED. Overtaken by the 2026-10-11 courtesy-notice ruling in F078 `## Rulings` (and criterion 6): a second report now sends the item to a person. `f078-criteria.test.ts:165` already says so. `sync-roadmap` amends the scenario.

criteria.text: Threat of harm or children texts Don at once; everything else queues in a mobile review view
criteria.note: `alertOperator` after commit: SMS when Twilio values exist, email through Resend today (#751); the mobile queue is `/admin/reports` [V]. Nobody is texted yet: no Twilio number (phone verification parked, #707) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.5]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #483 `review-skipped`; #751 no `Reviewed by:` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-14 [V]

criteria.text: Every report lands in the same queue, whether or not it hid anything
criteria.note: A report is always stored and queued; hiding is separate (`create.ts`) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.6]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green [V]

criteria.text: The hide bar stays per-metro data, no migration or deploy; zero at launch; unresolved metro uses zero
criteria.note: `metro_polygons.hide_bar` coalesces to 0, min() on overlap; the AI stays in shadow so no score drives hiding, as ruled (#626) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.7]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #494 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: A Threat of harm or Sensitive content report hides at once, on the first report, at any bar
criteria.note: `URGENT_CATEGORIES` bypass the bar, the courtesy step and the reporter limits (`create.ts`) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.8]` in `create.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #483 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: A report cannot be sent without a reason the reporter chose
criteria.note: Handler and sheet both refuse [V] Checked: `[guards F078.9]` in `create.test.ts` and `ReportControl.test.tsx` [V] Reviewed: #706, #705 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Before sending, the reporter is told misuse has consequences; rejected reports are strikes and after three stop hiding
criteria.note: Sheet line "Please don't misuse reports" (no numbers, per the 2026-10-11 copy ruling); strikes counted at report time in `create.ts` [V] Checked: `[guards F078.10]` sits on the strikes test only; the pre-send line test is unmarked (`ReportControl.test.tsx:336`); #834 [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Every string in the report path is kind and gracious; wording is Don's
